text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills fell to 53.92 percent from 57.25 percent at the last sale on September 13, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 36.745 million UAH 5.711 million UAH
Actual amount raised 32.390 million UAH 4.998 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 367,445 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 201,992 were competitive and 165,453 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for Wednesday.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 56.66 percent against 59.90 percent at the last sale on September 13, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 7,221 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 2,145 were competitive and 5,076 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for Wednesday.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills fell to 31.67 percent from 56.65 percent at the last sale on August 16, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 4,560 UAH 3.000 billion UAK
The central bank sold 60 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
On September 16 Ukraine removed the interim karbovanets currency (UAK) from circulation and introduced the hryvnia (UAH) in its place. Some transactions are still recorded in UAK.
--Yuri Kulikov, Kiev newsroom, +380 44 229-2264 $1 = 1.76 UAH / 1 UAH = 100,000 UAK
